'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Bill Kafer DS Power Of The Hutt''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Bill Kafer]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Bill Kafer]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Jabba's Palace|JP-D-tatooinejabbaspalace.gif}}
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
